_comment: Navigation of the edition by the objects readers work with (operator's rule 39 of 2026-11-14): one head item per object, and the representations of an object as a switch inside its view. One source for the static pages (build_site) and the interactive views (js/app.js). Paths are relative to the site root; the interactive views live under ansicht/. Every earlier address keeps working, since the views keep their routes.
